text: Frederic Kerrest assembles practical lessons from founders, investors, and business leaders around the stages of building a company. Combining their experiences with his own work at Salesforce and as an Okta cofounder, he addresses early decisions, hiring, culture, growth, setbacks, and preparing for public markets. Organized around the problems leaders encounter as they scale, the book follows entrepreneurship beyond an initial idea and through the responsibilities that continue after an IPO.
author: Frederic Kerrest
